title: PatchSetApplyResponse
description: Response body of POST /api/patch-sets/apply (HEL-406). One EditOutcome per edit in the caller's given order. When every edit applies cleanly, `failure` is absent and every outcome's status is 'applied'. When a mid-set failure triggers a rollback, `failure` carries the triggering error message and `edits` reports only the edits that were actually applied-then-compensated (design.md D3) -- see EditOutcome's own description for the status enum and the priorState/resultingState reuse-of-existing-response-shapes contract (design.md D4a/D4b).

failure.description: Present only when a mid-set failure triggered a rollback; carries the failing edit's error message.

applicationId.description: Present exactly when `failure` is absent AND the application was successfully journaled (HEL-413). POST /api/patch-sets/:id/undo accepts it later to restore this apply's pre-apply state. Absent for a partially-rolled-back apply and for any caller that predates this field.

EditOutcome.description: status: applied (no rollback needed) | rolledBack (a create/update edit was undone) | recreated (a panel/pipelineStep delete-rollback restored content under a NEW id) | unrecoverable (a dashboard/dataSource/pipeline delete-rollback could not restore the resource). priorState/resultingState reuse each target kind's EXISTING response shape (PanelResponse/DashboardResponse/DataSourceResponse/PipelineSummaryResponse/PipelineStepResponse) -- deliberately left as a generic object here rather than a five-way oneOf, since the concrete shape is determined by the edit's target.kind, not expressible as a single $ref. HEL-904 removed the `dataType` target kind outright (DataType/DataTypeResponse no longer exist).

index.description: The edit's position in the original patch set's edits array.

newId.description: The freshly minted id for a successful create, or the new id for a 'recreated' delete-rollback. Absent otherwise.

priorState.description: The resource's full pre-mutation state for an update/delete edit, serialized using its target kind's existing response shape. Absent for create edits.

resultingState.description: The resource's full post-mutation state for a successful create/update edit or a 'recreated' delete-rollback. Absent for a plain delete or an unrecoverable rollback.
